MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable Bluetooth speaker would let me listen away from my desk without wearing headphones, adding a useful option alongside my existing audio gear.",
    "Audio was a reasonable connection to my headphone purchases, especially when it offered a different use rather than another pair of headphones."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers, smart displays and smart plug assume I want voice control or home automation, but I have no current task that calls for those features.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender misses my recent effort to use wired networking through an Ethernet adapter and cables.",
    "The streaming sticks and tablet add devices without addressing my current computer setup needs; owning a Raspberry Pi and Kindle does not mean I am seeking replacements or upgrades."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any connected gadget.",
    "My Kindle purchase seems to have been taken as a broader preference for Amazon devices, even though reading does not establish a need for Alexa or streaming hardware."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, patch cables, headphone mount and blower duster point toward connecting, organizing and maintaining equipment I already own.",
    "My accessory purchases tend to serve specific practical tasks, so a recommendation needs to explain what useful capability it adds to my existing setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but mostly missed my current focus on practical improvements to equipment I already use."
}
